en-GB.name: Clock Widget
en-GB.summary: A clean date and time widget for your Echo Show.
en-GB.description: Adds a clean clock to your Echo Show widget panel showing the current time and date. Tap the clock to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask clock widget how do I add the widget

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the widget gallery on an Echo Show, add Clock, and check the time and date. Tap the widget to toggle 12/24-hour time.
